Carga + HIS_raw\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"3719c12d-183e-4baf-a167-539080f3fed3","cell_type":"code","source":"def his_raw(h_id, h_re):\n    d = abs(h_id)\n    if d < EPS:\n        return float(\"nan\")\n    return max(0.0, 1.0 - abs(h_id - h_re) / d)\n\ndef make_workload(n, depth, idle_us):\n    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)\n    for layer in range(depth):\n        for i in range(n):\n            qc.h(i)\n            qc.rz(0.3 + 0.02 * layer, i)\n        for i in range(n - 1):\n            qc.cx(i, i + 1)\n        qc.barrier()\n        for i in range(n):\n            qc.delay(idle_us, i, unit=\"us\")\n        qc.barrier()\n    return qc\n\ndef make_H(n):\n    terms = []\n    for i in range(n - 1):\n        z = [\"I\"] * n\n        z[i], z[i + 1] = \"Z\", \"Z\"\n        terms.append((\"\".join(z), -0.5))\n        terms.append((\"I\" * n, 0.25 / max(n - 1, 1)))\n    return SparsePauliOp.from_list(terms).simplify()\n\nQC0 = make_workload(N, P, CONFIG[\"idle_us\"])\nH = make_H(N)\nH_IDEAL = float(np.real(Statevector.from_instruction(QC0).expectation_value(H)))\nprint(\"ops=%d depth=%d  <H>_ideal=%.4f\" % (QC0.size(), QC0.depth(), H_IDEAL))\nassert abs(H_IDEAL) > 0.2\nassert abs(his_raw(H_IDEAL, 0.0)) < 1e-9\nprint(\"HIS_raw(ideal,0)=0 OK | HIS_raw(ideal,ideal)=%.2f\" % his_raw(H_IDEAL, H_IDEAL))\n\ndef estimate_H(counts, n):\n    labels = H.paulis.to_labels()\n    coeffs = np.real(H.coeffs)\n    total = sum(counts.values()) or 1\n    e = 0.0\n    for bs, c in counts.items():\n        s = bs.replace(\" \", \"\")[-n:].zfill(n)\n        val = 0.0\n        for lab, w in zip(labels, coeffs):\n            par = 0\n            for i, ch in enumerate(lab):\n                if ch != \"I\" and s[i] == \"1\":\n                    par ^= 1\n            val += w * (1 - 2 * par)\n        e += (c / total) * val\n    return e\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-15T05:20:40.090918Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-15T05:20:40.091317Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-15T05:20:40.141486Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-15T05:20:40.091297Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-15T05:20:40.140632Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"ops=248 depth=80  <H>_ideal=-1.2488\nHIS_raw(ideal,0)=0 OK | HIS_raw(ideal,ideal)=1.00\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":3},{"id":"9bf39418-ae9e-421d-92a5-fd76fa04e055","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 3. Buenos: ruido base * scale (deriva).\"\"\"\n    nm = NoiseModel()\n    for q in range(M):\n        bad = q in bad_set\n        if bad:\n            p1 = min(0.49, CONFIG[\"p1_bad\"])\n            pr = min(0.49, CONFIG[\"pro_bad\"])\n        else:\n            p1 = min(0.49, CONFIG[\"p1_good\"] * scale)\n            pr = min(0.49, CONFIG[\"pro_good\"] * scale)\n        nm.add_readout_error(ReadoutError([[1 - pr, pr], [pr, 1 - pr]]), [q])\n        nm.add_quantum_error(depolarizing_error(p1, 1), [\"h\", \"rz\", \"x\", \"sx\", \"id\"], [q])\n\n    for a in range(M - 1):\n        bad_e = (a in bad_set) or ((a + 1) in bad_set)\n        if bad_e:\n            p2 = min(0.49, CONFIG[\"p2_bad\"])\n        else:\n            p2 = min(0.49, CONFIG[\"p2_good\"] * scale)\n        e = depolarizing_error(p2, 2)\n        nm.add_quantum_error(e, [\"cx\"], [a, a + 1])\n        nm.add_quantum_error(e, [\"cx\"], [a + 1, a])\n    return nm\n\nBAD = set(range(CONFIG[\"n_bad\"]))\nfr = np.array([0.90 if q in BAD else 0.08 for q in range(M)], float)\nMOTOR[\"ojos\"] = {\"active\": True, \"detail\": \"bad=%s mean_fr=%.3f\" % (sorted(BAD), float(fr.mean()))}\nprint(MOTOR[\"ojos\"][\"detail\"])\nprint(\"drift scale c0=%.2f c10=%.2f c20=%.2f c30=%.2f\" % (\n    drift_scale(0), drift_scale(10), drift_scale(20), drift_scale(30)))\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-15T05:20:40.142358Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-15T05:20:40.142580Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-15T05:20:40.151146Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-15T05:20:40.142562Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-15T05:20:40.150253Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"bad=[0, 1, 2, 3, 4] mean_fr=0.373\ndrift scale c0=1.00 c10=3.11 c20=9.65 c30=29.96\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":4},{"id":"e0693403-b622-4b9b-9795-773f07b5f767","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 4. edges:\n    adj[a].append(b); adj[b].append(a)\n\ndef path_layouts(n_log, blacklist):\n    bl = set(blacklist)\n    found = []\n    def dfs(path):\n        if len(found) >= 40: return\n        if return float(np.mean([fr[q] for q in layout]))\n\nblacklist = [q for q in range(M) if fr[q] >= 0.5]\npaths = path_layouts(N, blacklist) or path_layouts(N, [])\npaths = sorted(paths, M))\nassert LAYOUT_EQG != LAYOUT_NONE\nassert score(LAYOUT_EQG) < 0.2 and score(LAYOUT_NONE) > 0.4\n\nMOTOR[\"reflejos\"] = {\"active\": True, \"detail\": \"sin=%s eqg=%s\" % (LAYOUT_NONE,
